text:
ITEM 1 | Long thin green beans, bright green with slightly darker tips, some with pale stem ends, smooth glossy skin, cooked until just tender with slight wrinkling, arranged in a fanned pile covering roughly 25% of the plate on the left side, each bean about 8-10 cm long and 0.5 cm thick, piled 1-2 cm high | 110

ITEM 2 | Brown-red cooked grain with visible dark specks, loosely clumped, dry-looking matte surface, individual grains about 0.5 cm, mounded in the center-right covering roughly 35% of the plate and about 2 cm high, scattered with a few darker bits and small brown fragments | 230

ITEM 3 | Halved cherry tomatoes, bright red with glossy moist skin and pale seed interiors, some partly squashed, scattered among the grain in the lower center, each about 2-3 cm across, covering roughly 8% of the plate, about 1 cm high | 70

ITEM 4 | Pale golden-white sliced onion or similar soft strips, slightly translucent with light browning at edges, limp and moist, pieces about 3-4 cm long, sitting under and among the grain near the center, covering roughly 5% of the plate, about 0.5 cm thick | 25

ITEM 5 | Orange-red flaky cooked fish or meat piece with pale translucent edges, moist and slightly flaky texture, rests at top center under grain, piece about 6 x 4 cm, covering roughly 6% of the plate, about 1.5 cm high | 60

ITEM 6 | Golden-brown seared piece, lightly charred edges with light browning, firm and dry-looking surface, positioned at right edge partly under grain, about 6 x 3 cm, covering roughly 4% of the plate, about 1 cm high | 35

ITEM 7 | Dark brown crumbly bits and small fragments scattered across the grain and plate, matte and dry, each under 0.5 cm | 5
